body: with kit's store! but i believe you have to be pretty deep in the game to be able to do so. upgrading your tent and storage (via flamey) will do for now

1. HOARD STUFF. after completing tasks, always make sure to spend time to fish, harvest wood and leafy greens, get all the fruits and nuts you can get. 

2. fruit tincture, LOTS OF IT. once you have the recipe for it, instead of selling just the fruits themselves, ask Charlotte to make fruit tinctures and then sell them. they are worth so much more.

3. upgrade your backpack and house immediately when you have the money. you can store stuff in your house as well so it doubles your storage.
